workflow.title: Workflow automation
workflow.description: Systems that handle repetitive tasks. Integrations between tools. Processes that run without supervision.

data.title: Data processing
data.description: Collecting, structuring, and utilizing operational data. Transformations that make business sense.

integration.title: System integration
integration.description: Connecting scattered tools into one cohesive ecosystem. APIs, webhooks, real-time synchronization.

analysis.title: Analysis and reporting
analysis.description: Dashboards that show real data. Process monitoring. Notifications that matter.

howItWorks.headline: HOW WE WORK.
howItWorks.subtitle: Plan first. System second.

understand.title: Understanding the business
understand.description: We don't automate every task. Not every problem is solved by AI. We create solutions tailored to specific companies.

plan.title: Implementation plan
plan.description: Detailed scenario: what, how, and in what order. No surprises. Option to withdraw at any stage.

system.title: System that works
system.description: Implementation in iterations. Testing in real conditions. Systems that operate stably and predictably.

support.title: Process ownership
support.description: We transfer full control. Documentation that makes sense. Support when needed.

approach.title: Plan first. System second.
approach.description: We don't start with tools. We start by understanding what actually requires automation and what requires human decision-making.

custom.title: Tailored solutions
custom.description: We don't offer ready-made templates. Each company operates differently. We design every implementation from scratch.

control.title: Full control
control.description: The system belongs to you. Complete documentation. Ability to modify. No dependency on external provider.

commonMistake.headline: THIS MISTAKE KILLS MOST AI IMPLEMENTATIONS.
